caption: The drawing depicts a single, worn leather shoe with a pronounced, thick heel and a square toe. The shoe appears to be brown with darker patches and creases, indicating extensive use and wear. The upper part of the shoe is wrinkled and slouched, with visible stitching along the edges. The heel is chunky and has a cutout detail on the inner side, creating a distinctive shape. The shoe is placed centrally on a plain, untextured background with no other objects present. In the bottom right corner, there is a faint inscription reading "MICHAEL J. FRANCE."
title: Man's Shoe
